---
title: "Packed State Embedding Bags"
format: html
---

`packed_embedding_bag_forward` gathers learned feature-specific embeddings
directly from a bit-packed state for an explicit list of active `(row, feature)`
occurrences. It never decodes the full dense state. Caller-supplied segment
offsets group occurrences into ragged bags, such as a cell/module's selected
genes. Each feature has its own contiguous table range, sized to its codebook
levels and the common embedding dimension.

The implementation reuses Cellerator's 1/2/4/8-bit packed code layout and
physical-feature to profile-feature mapping. Each bag result is a weighted sum
of its occurrence embeddings. FP16 or FP32 tables/outputs are supported, with
FP32 accumulation.

## Exact state values

An exact-value override has a meaningful lookup interpretation: the value is
located between adjacent feature codebook levels, and its embedding is linearly
interpolated between those learned rows. Values beyond the codebook range use
the nearest endpoint. Override indices must be sorted by logical state index
for device binary search. The quantization encoder's append order is not sorted;
callers should sort the paired index/value entries before passing them. Indices
must also be unique. An empty sidecar explicitly means lookup is based on
packed codes only.

The profile codebooks, feature map, table offsets, packed words, occurrence
lists, weights, output buffers, and status storage are borrowed. Device offsets
and contents remain the caller's responsibility; malformed state positions,
segments, feature mappings, table ranges, and nonfinite sidecar/weights set the
device status bits. Reset status on the supplied stream before work. Calls are
asynchronous and allocate no hidden buffers.

## Gradients

Backward uses the same active occurrences. It atomically adds embedding
gradients into a caller-owned FP32 table-gradient buffer; zero that buffer
before backward when overwrite behavior is desired. Optional occurrence-weight
gradients are assigned per occurrence. Packed codes, occurrence selection,
feature mappings, and exact values are conditioning inputs and receive no
gradients.

The compile/link smoke fixture checks a host oracle for ragged weighted bags,
an exact-value interpolation, and first-order gradients. It does not launch the
GPU implementation; numerical GPU validation remains pending scheduler
admission.
